mapping_semantics: Traceability is not equivalence: an FC1 subset check does not verify a whole HATCH feature; named expansions never downgrade required foundations.

features.title: Language identity, modes and policy
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: Versioned .naja edition, independent semantics and separately pinned/tested .py compatibility; no runtime or package equivalence claim.
One shared syntax/resolution model across compiler, formatter, LSP, debugger and cells; edition/import/alias/policy/interface cache identity.
Hosted/core/embedded capability checks preserve arithmetic, OS permission and explicit allocation/IO boundaries.
Versioned compatibility matrices distinguish grammar/semantics/library/ABI; no CPython fallback.

features.title: Explicit, indented and named blocks
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: Indented suites and nesting-depth markers retain sibling and companion-clause meaning.
Colon-opened brace suites execute without indentation; labeled standalone sections preserve scope, order and cleanup boundaries.
Single-line label metadata, clause ownership and mixed delimiter stacks diagnose missing labels/braces and unsupported combined decorations.
Maps/sets, strings/comments, regexes, interpolation and multiline expressions retain source identities; equivalent formatting preserves control flow/source maps.

features.title: Project aliases
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: Token/AST-aware comparison and builtin/function aliases preserve precedence, comparison chains, evaluation and original locations.
Project/module imports scope aliases; local binding/member names, dependency sources, strings/comments/patterns remain untouched.
Unicode aliases, reserved-name conflicts, shadowing and ambiguity have deterministic diagnostics and cache invalidation.
Glyph aliases map to existing canonical token operators with unchanged precedence/semantics.

features.title: Uniform object capabilities and representations
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: Native ordinary values/classes expose methods/properties with explicit value/reference, identity/equality/hash, mutability/lifetime/layout contracts.
Inference, generics/protocols and flow-sensitive narrowing use resolved reusable algebra identities, not trusted method names.
Hosted arbitrary integers remain distinct from checked machine integers and named wrapping/saturating operations; inline representation is permitted without universal boxing.

features.title: Controlled class extensions
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: Explicit scoped imports add methods/computed properties without stored fields, layout mutation, private access or hidden initialization.
Real/inherited members win; ambiguity is diagnosed with qualified-call escape; operator/protocol/conversion coherence obeys ownership or explicit adapters.

features.title: Partial classes with authorized folders
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: One qualified primary class owns fields, bases, generic parameters, constructors and ABI; declared parts add only permitted behavior.
Enumerated same-package roots/directories/files are canonicalized; traversal, symlinks, case collisions, foreign fragments and duplicate signatures reject.
Generated parts are explicit/reproducible with provenance; no recursive ambient discovery or install-time code execution.

features.title: Typed numeric literals
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: In-scope user-defined literal-construction protocol determines eligible suffixes; arbitrary class names work without a built-in unit table.
Decimal/exponent/base/sign/underscore/complex-suffix collisions diagnose ambiguity; exact literal text avoids lossy binary-float round trips.
Unknown/ambiguous suffix types reject; ordinary identifiers and conventional/qualified constructors retain meaning and observable construction effects.

features.title: Relations and derived operations
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: Reusable algebra, dimension/family relations and scalar promotion are distinct; exact scale composition derives only valid operators.
Quantity add/subtract retain the declared left representation without truncation; division/dimension rules and equal-value hashes remain coherent.
Contradictory relation cycles, ambiguous paths and incompatible dimensions reject; inheritance does not follow automatically from conversion.
Declared invertible affine relations derive rational maps and inverse maps; points/deltas, bounds and nonlinear/refused operations remain distinct.

features.title: Constrained and pattern-derived values
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: Inclusive numeric intervals define numeric policy, empty bounds, overflow/NaN/infinity and refinement loss after arithmetic.
Construction, assignment/mutation, external input, FFI and deserialization establish invariants; constant proof does not remove necessary runtime checks.
Full-match bounded patterns expose numbered/named typed captures with declared optional/repeated semantics, collision checks and checked numeric parsing.
Local structural identities and named/versioned exported schemas use immutable backing storage or lifetime-safe views; text updates revalidate.

features.title: Native validated structured values
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: Native Email and IPv4/IPv6/IPAddress values provide checked properties and round-trip serialization; extensible URL/UUID-style parser contracts remain native.
Email syntax is separate from existence and implicit DNS; domain/Unicode normalization preserves local-part meaning.
IP structure handles declared prefixes/zones/canonical display and invalid input; parsing is not authorization, trust or reachability.

features.title: Conversions and concise collections
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: ToString/ToInt/ToFloat/ToDecimal/To(Type) and failure-aware conversions use explicit invariant formats, named rounding and observable effects.
.naja resolves native operations first; narrowly defined lossless compile-time string constants may participate in numeric multiplication, while dynamic text requires explicit checked parsing.
String concatenation and explicit Repeat remain distinct; overload lookup, equality/hash, decimal promotion and .py semantics are not silently changed.
Variadic scalar sum and collection sum with named start, mean and reductions define empty/mixed input, precision and overflow behavior.

features.title: Numerical/data and functional foundations
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: Native Array/Vector/Matrix/Tensor/DataFrame contracts define dtype/rank/shape/layout/strides, views/copies/ownership, mutation, broadcasting and devices.
Elementwise and contraction operators, reductions/axes, norms/dot/matmul, bounded selected solves/decompositions, statistics and geometry execute with stated precision/degeneracy limits.
Schema-aware bounded CSV/JSONL transformations/grouping preserve missingness, deterministic output and resource/error/cancellation policies.
Pipeline fusion/specialization/vectorization/parallelism require compatible effect/alias/shape and strict numerical contracts; approximate reassociation and device movement are explicit.
Sparse/advanced solver catalogs extend dtype/shape/precision and explicit failure interfaces.
Device/effect/shape transformations require explicit selection, resource/precision policies and backend evidence.
Versioned native model loading/inference/training interfaces declare dtype/shape, device, resources and effects.
Arrow/NPY/Parquet and other adapters declare schema, layout, ownership, lifetime and missingness.

features.title: Native execution and typed events
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: Sync/async, independent native CPU threads, bounded pools/task groups, parallel map/reduce, channels/locks/atomics and cancellation have real execution evidence.
Parent/join/exception/deadlock/queue/backpressure/lifecycle and detached ownership rules avoid an ordinary CPU-work global interpreter lock.
Typed custom/file/network/system and one real focused-application input path share observable bounded subscription/disposal and per-instance state.
UI affinity and async-handler ordering are explicit; global hooks/privileged devices require consent, and interrupt-safe deferred work differs from heap-allocating GUI handlers.
Platform adapters share subscription/affinity/capability interfaces.
Tool/model/event contracts expose permissions, budgets, cancellation and external service boundaries.
Structured lifetime/message/error/supervision interfaces remain usable without a distributed runtime dependency.

features.title: Concise applications, hardware and domains
features.fc1_scope: HATCH foundation; FC1 does not require this complete domain workflow.

reflections.contract: Real two-line TCP/HTTP facades retain framing/partial writes, local defaults, bounded buffers, cancellation and cleanup without networking-specific grammar.
Hardware observation/control/instruction construction obey target/ABI/permissions; FFI and hosted/core/embedded separation retain real freestanding proof.
Bounded native numerical/AI extension pilots and a local quantum simulator remain inherited HATCH demonstrations, with model/tool/permission/budget/event interfaces and no canned outputs.
Platform adapters share subscription/affinity/capability interfaces.
Versioned native model loading/inference/training interfaces declare dtype/shape, device, resources and effects.
Tool/model/event contracts expose permissions, budgets, cancellation and external service boundaries.
Backend-specific resource/measurement contracts require separate explicit authorization and real evidence.
Capability-specific native adapters expose permissions, resources, timing and declared supported targets.

features.title: Compiler insight, contracts and metaprogramming
features.fc1_scope: Only the FC1-relevant subset is mapped; all remaining required reflections stay open.

reflections.contract: Minimal Lens/inspect explains actual resolved types/conversions/assembly, known allocation/transform/refusal facts; unknown measurements remain unknown.

Intent chooses legal strategies under effect/shape/precision constraints; proof, runtime validation and assertions are distinct and unverified algebra/purity annotations never justify unsafe optimization.
Bounded deterministic compile-time/derive generation has hygienic visible typed expansion/source maps, declared inputs/capabilities and no silent network/filesystem/secret access.
Scientific transformation and actor/supervision interfaces preserve supported subsets, structured lifetime, messaging/error contracts and explicit refusal without imposing a distributed runtime.
Device/effect/shape transformations require explicit selection, resource/precision policies and backend evidence.
Cost models expose measured versus unknown facts and select only semantically legal strategies.
Versioned typed effect/shape transformations expose generated code and explicit unsupported diagnostics.
Structured lifetime/message/error/supervision interfaces remain usable without a distributed runtime dependency.

test_groups.title: Edition, compatibility and capabilities
positive_boundaries: Separate .py/.naja edition behavior and shared resolver/cache identity
Declared hosted/core/embedded operations preserve numeric meaning
negative_boundaries: NAJA coercions must not leak into .py or dependency sources
Unavailable capability and stale edition/alias cache entries reject

test_groups.title: Block parsing
positive_boundaries: Nested/mixed suites, indentation-free braces, metadata labels, transparent scope and equivalent control flow
Dictionaries/sets, multiline expressions, interpolation and clause ownership
negative_boundaries: Missing braces/labels, misplaced clauses and ambiguous mixtures
Depth/brace combined decorations reject until supported; strings/comments remain untouched

test_groups.title: Contextual aliases and imports
positive_boundaries: Canonical/alias operators preserve comparison-chain evaluation and source spans
Module/project Unicode aliases and binding shadowing
negative_boundaries: Reserved/conflicting/ambiguous aliases and dependency leakage
Strings, regexes, comments, members and unrelated identifiers must not be rewritten

test_groups.title: Ordinary values and object/protocol semantics
positive_boundaries: Functions, closures, scopes, classes, fields/methods and generic/protocol dispatch
Hosted integers, explicit checked machine values and equality/hash/lifetime semantics
negative_boundaries: Bare arbitrary integers must not silently narrow; overflow and invalid scope/type operations reject
Unverified algebra/purity names do not grant compiler authority

test_groups.title: Literals and relations
positive_boundaries: Decimal/exponent/base lexical precedence and arbitrary user-defined eligible class names
Exact promotion, left representation, scale division and affine points/deltas
negative_boundaries: Unknown/ambiguous suffixes, dimension errors, relation cycles and contradictory paths
Point+point, invalid affine assumptions and equality/hash mismatch

test_groups.title: Smart values
positive_boundaries: Inclusive bounds and runtime construction/assignment/external input validation
Named/numbered/optional/repeated checked captures and immutable backing storage
Native Email/IP/URL/UUID profiles and serialization round trips
negative_boundaries: Empty bounds, overflow/NaN, invalid/malicious patterns, property collisions and work-budget exhaustion
Mutable/shared backing storage and unchecked FFI/deserialization must not bypass invariants

test_groups.title: Partials and extensions
positive_boundaries: Same-package enumerated primary/part assembly and scoped extension lookup
Actual/inherited member precedence and qualified-call escape
negative_boundaries: Traversal/symlink/case collisions, disallowed paths, external fragments, duplicate members/constructors
Extension ambiguity, field/layout/private-access changes and foreign coherence violations

test_groups.title: Conversions
positive_boundaries: Valid constant numeric context and explicit checked dynamic conversion
Locale-independent formats, declared rounding/promotion and display after numeric evaluation
negative_boundaries: Invalid constants, dynamic string fallback and accidental string repetition
Overflow, undeclared locale/truncation and observable conversion-effect loss

test_groups.title: Numerical and data foundations
positive_boundaries: Shape-aware arrays/vectors/matrices/tensors, exact/strict reductions and bounded math/statistics/geometry
Schema-aware CSV/JSONL, deterministic grouping/output and cancellation/cleanup
negative_boundaries: Shape/type/broadcast failures, view aliasing, missingness, precision/overflow and singular/degenerate inputs
Unbounded groups/memory and silent approximate reassociation or device movement

test_groups.title: Concurrency and events
positive_boundaries: Independent CPU tasks, async waits, shared-memory synchronization and structured lifecycle
Custom/file/network/real application-input events with bounded per-instance subscribers
negative_boundaries: Cancellation/exceptions/queue limits, leaks, reentrancy and lost handler errors
Incorrect UI affinity, unconsented global hooks and unavailable OS capabilities

test_groups.title: Cells and AOT isolation
positive_boundaries: Native definitions, version retention, correct selection context and interrupt/reset
Standalone release inputs and measured unused-controller independence
negative_boundaries: Automatic replay, discarded enclosing conditions, unsafe live-code unload
Session-state dependencies and unreported cold/warm/AOT overhead

test_groups.title: Compiler trust and transformations
positive_boundaries: Visible resolved generated code/source maps and refusal reasons
Bounded deterministic compile-time/derive with declared capabilities
negative_boundaries: Unverified purity/algebra claims, hidden IO/secret access and resource-limit bypass
Fabricated measurements and unsupported effect/shape transformations

test_groups.title: Recovery and ownership
positive_boundaries: Fresh-agent takeover from durable state, actual lock/owner checks and tested resume
Separate unknown quota/context/rate/deadline/spend telemetry and bounded retries
negative_boundaries: Unexpected exit, dirty/malformed/stale checkpoint and newer conflicting state
False clean/tested/handoff claims, fake running receiver and paid/permission bypass

test_groups.title: Native CLI and editor
positive_boundaries: CLI build/check/run/test/help and deterministic modules with shared diagnostics
Installable VSIX build/run, original source maps and minimal actual inspect/explain
negative_boundaries: Invalid/unsupported source, workspace trust and stale resolver/source locations
Fake debugger/completion, undisclosed target mismatch or successful no-op tooling

test_groups.title: Preview installation and artifacts
positive_boundaries: Clean reference-target native install and independently supplied programs
Reproducible source/artifact identities, checksums and truthful preview/recovery summary
negative_boundaries: Hidden Python/seed execution service, cached answers or unavailable undeclared runtime
Missing artifacts, source mismatch or FC1 falsely closing inherited release gates

test_groups.title: Applications, hardware and bounded pilots
positive_boundaries: Real TCP/HTTP clients, framing/lifecycle and explicit hardware/FFI permissions
Freestanding execution and native numerical/local quantum extension pilots
negative_boundaries: Partial writes, malformed requests, resource exhaustion and unsafe FFI boundaries
Unapproved cloud/QPU/privileged input, hard-coded domain outputs or hidden foreign execution

expansions.title: Advanced scientific catalogs
expansions.interface_contract: Sparse/advanced solver catalogs extend dtype/shape/precision and explicit failure interfaces.
expansions.reason: Bounded math/statistics/geometry and inherited numerical pilots remain mandatory.

expansions.title: GPU and general automatic differentiation
expansions.interface_contract: Device/effect/shape transformations require explicit selection, resource/precision policies and backend evidence.
expansions.reason: Native numeric foundations and supported transformation refusal are required; broad GPU/autodiff catalogs are expansion.

expansions.title: Full cross-platform GUI and OS event catalogs
expansions.reason: One actual declared application-input path is a mandatory foundation; all widgets/OS events are not inferred from callbacks.

expansions.title: Complete ML and local LLM framework
expansions.interface_contract: Versioned native model loading/inference/training interfaces declare dtype/shape, device, resources and effects.
expansions.reason: Required bounded numerical/extension pilots remain mandatory; model responses cannot be canned or delegated secretly.

expansions.title: Full native agent ecosystem
expansions.interface_contract: Tool/model/event contracts expose permissions, budgets, cancellation and external service boundaries.
expansions.reason: Required permission/budget/event interfaces remain foundational; an entire agent catalog is expansion.

expansions.title: External QPU execution
expansions.interface_contract: Backend-specific resource/measurement contracts require separate explicit authorization and real evidence.
expansions.reason: The inherited local simulator/quantum extension demonstration remains mandatory; remote execution is optional.

expansions.title: Advanced cost/energy and intent optimization
expansions.interface_contract: Cost models expose measured versus unknown facts and select only semantically legal strategies.
expansions.reason: Minimal truthful inspect/explain and legal strategy contracts are required; global optimality is not promised.

expansions.title: General transformation and incremental engines
expansions.interface_contract: Versioned typed effect/shape transformations expose generated code and explicit unsupported diagnostics.
expansions.reason: Bounded compile-time/derive, trustworthy source maps and permitted basic transforms remain foundations.

expansions.title: Distributed actors and supervision runtime
expansions.interface_contract: Structured lifetime/message/error/supervision interfaces remain usable without a distributed runtime dependency.
expansions.reason: Local tasks/events and actor extension contracts are required; full distributed runtime/catalog is expansion.

expansions.title: Additional native interchange adapters
expansions.interface_contract: Arrow/NPY/Parquet and other adapters declare schema, layout, ownership, lifetime and missingness.
expansions.reason: Required bounded CSV/JSONL and dataframe foundations remain mandatory; arbitrary pandas compatibility is not claimed.

expansions.title: Full Python packages and ABI ecosystem
expansions.interface_contract: Versioned compatibility matrices distinguish grammar/semantics/library/ABI; no CPython fallback.
expansions.reason: Retains inherited future objectives without weakening the pinned .py parsing/support obligations.

expansions.title: Broad robotics/device/application catalogs
expansions.interface_contract: Capability-specific native adapters expose permissions, resources, timing and declared supported targets.
expansions.reason: Portable/hardware primitives, application-input and freestanding HATCH foundations remain mandatory.

expansions.title: Optional glyph alias catalog
expansions.interface_contract: Glyph aliases map to existing canonical token operators with unchanged precedence/semantics.
expansions.reason: Contextual six-comparison/builtin aliases and Unicode identifier policy remain required.
